items.title: MakeMyTrip Set to File for India IPO at $1 Billion-Plus: Report
items.summary: MakeMyTrip has talked about an India listing for months. A confidential filing — if the report holds — would be the clearest sign yet the company is moving from considering it to doing it.

items.title: Air India Rebuilds Its App With In-House Booking, Payments, and AI
items.summary: Yes, they made the app better and nicer! But the bigger story is that Air India is angling for a future where your flight, hotel and cab all get booked (and fixed, if something goes wrong) as one thing, not three separate headaches.

items.title: Awe, Not Excess: The Market Signal Luxury Travel Can’t Afford to Miss
items.summary: The affluent traveler's definition of luxury has shifted faster than most operators realize. Lindblad Expeditions is proof that the brands built around depth of experience and purposeful discovery are gaining a competitive edge.

items.title: The Business Value of Skift Global Forum
items.summary: Distribution is up for grabs, AI is in the core systems, capital has gotten careful, and loyalty is being redefined. Skift Global Forum is where travel decides what to do about it.

items.title: Omio to Buy Rail Europe, Consolidating Ground Transport — Exclusive
items.summary: By absorbing Rail Europe, a 5-million-ticket rail seller with 90-plus years of operator ties, Omio is consolidating one of travel's most fragmented, hard-to-book corners — and laying groundwork for when AI agents book trips, not just suggest them.

items.title: JetBlue Ties Loyalty Points to Flight Financing
items.summary: The airline's frequent flyer program was built to reward spending. JetBlue is using it as a pipeline to finance spending — and letting customers earn points for the privilege of paying interest.

items.title: Travel + Leisure Buys Into Maui and Hilton Head in $343 Million Deal
items.summary: The timeshare secret runs best on people who already said yes. So when it gets harder to land first-time buyers, buy someone else's customers.

items.title: United Airlines Raises Outlook, Higher Fares Offset $6 Billion in Added Fuel Expense
items.summary: United is betting that it will continue to see high travel demand in the second half of 2026 as it stares down at an additional $6 billion in fuel costs.
